## SBLNET – PT Surya Bestari Lestari (AS152060)

Indonesian broadband ISP headquartered in Jakarta, delivering fiber internet to residential, business and enterprise customers across Jabodetabek, West Java, Central Java, East Java and Bangka Belitung.

### Peering
- **Policy:** Open – we peer with everyone, no ratio or contract required
- **Route servers:** connected at all IXPs listed below
- **Bilateral sessions:** welcome – email us with your ASN and IXP
- **Max-prefix:** IPv4 10
- **IRR:** APNIC::AS152060 (route objects registered in IDNIC)
- **MTU:** 1500
- **Looking glass:** https://lg.sblnet.id

### Where to find us
- **JKT-IX** – 10G
- **IIX-Jakarta** – 10G
- **ILIX** – 10G
- **Facility:** Datacenter APJII-Cyber, Jakarta Selatan
